name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns for Server Components, streaming, routing, data fetching, caching, and full-stack apps. Use when building/migrating Next.js apps, implementing SSR/SSG, or optimizing React Server Components.

## Choose a mode
- Server Components: server-only data fetching, heavy computation, secrets.
- Client Components: interactivity, hooks, browser APIs.
- Static: build-time, rarely changing content. Dynamic: request-time, personalized/real-time. Streaming: progressive large pages/slow sources.

## App Router
Common files: `layout.tsx` (shared UI), `page.tsx` (route), `loading.tsx` (Suspense UI), `error.tsx` (error boundary), `not-found.tsx` (404), `route.ts` (API), `template.tsx` (remounted layout), `default.tsx` (parallel-route fallback), `opengraph-image.tsx` (OG image).

`app/layout.tsx`: root layout, metadata, fonts, providers, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>` and `<body>`.
`app/page.tsx`: Server Component by default; fetch with `next: { revalidate: 3600 }` for hourly ISR.
`app/products/page.tsx`: `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`; await params and pass category, sort, page (`Number(params.page) || 1`). Use `<Suspense>` and `key={JSON.stringify(params)}` for filters.
`components/products/ProductList.tsx`: colocate async fetching; use `process.env.API_URL`, `new URLSearchParams(filters)`, cache tags (`{ next: { tags: ['products'] } }`), check `res.ok`; render grid/cards and pagination.
`components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: client interactivity with `useState`, `useTransition`; invoke `addToCart`, show pending/error states.
`app/actions/cart.ts`: Server Actions; use `cookies()` for session, database mutations, `revalidateTag`; validate checkout `FormData`, then `redirect(`/orders/${order.id}/confirmation`)`.
`app/dashboard/layout.tsx`: parallel slots `children`, `analytics`, `team`; render independent panels. Slot files: `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`, `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx`.
Intercepting photo modal paths: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx` and full-page `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx`; root `app/layout.tsx` accepts `modal: React.ReactNode`.
`app/product/[id]/page.tsx`: await `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`; fetch critical product first, stream reviews/recommendations in separate `<Suspense>` boundaries with skeletons; each component fetches its own data.
`app/api/products/route.ts`: `GET(request: NextRequest)` reads `request.nextUrl.searchParams`, returns `NextResponse.json`; `POST` parses JSON and returns status 201.
`app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`: await promised params; query DB; return 404 JSON if absent, otherwise product JSON.
`app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`: await slug params; `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`; call `notFound()` if absent; return product detail. Metadata can include title, description, Open Graph image and Twitter card.

## Fetch/cache patterns
`fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" })` (always fresh); `fetch(url, { cache: "force-cache" })` (static); `fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` (ISR); `fetch(url, { next: { tags: ["products"] } })` (tagged).
`import { revalidateTag, revalidatePath } from "next/cache";` In Server Actions, update DB then invalidate relevant tag/path.

## Guidelines
**Start with Server Components** - Add 'use client' only when needed
**Colocate data fetching** - Fetch data where it's used
**Use Suspense boundaries** - Enable streaming for slow data
**Leverage parallel routes** - Independent loading states
**Use Server Actions** - For mutations with progressive enhancement
**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
